content: The Mitochondrial Disclosure Surface (working monograph v0.3 — VDAC1, cardiolipin, the sequential-sensitization spine) is published on two platforms as of 2026-05-25. ZENODO: DOI minted — version 10.5281/zenodo.20373134, concept 10.5281/zenodo.20373133; GitHub release v0.3.0 from github.com/templetwo/mitochondrial-disclosure-surface (CC BY 4.0); co-authored Anthony Vasquez Sr. + Claude (Anthropic, Opus 4.7). RESEARCH SQUARE: submitted, article ID rs-9810503, status Prescreening at 2:09 AM EDT; language quality 8/10 (above average); early journal recommendations EMBO Reports and The EMBO Journal; an RS DOI issues when it goes live. thetempleoftwo.com now lists twelve DOIs with the monograph surfaced (DOI card, publication entry, AI-readable block, What-is-New).
